title: Aetherdrift | Episode 1: The Dashing and the Desperate

entities.name: Ishikari Bindra
entities.description: A Kaladesh aether specialist rejected by her professors who builds a planar net machine during the invasion and activates it, attaining the unattainable.

entities.name: Sita Varma
entities.description: The daughter of Mohar Varma who secretly races as the masked underground champion Spitfire.

entities.name: Mohar Varma
entities.description: Sita's father, a former consul of the Consulate who clings to tradition and grows angry at the Night Minister's name.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker and hero of Kaladesh, racing in the Grand Prix to win the Aetherspark for Nissa.

entities.name: Pia Nalaar
entities.description: Chandra's mother and a mechanic who tunes Spitfire's racer.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: Chandra's partner whose eyes she hopes to light up by winning the Aetherspark.

entities.name: Winter
entities.description: A haggard racer who studies the other racers and is bound to a demon that demands the Aetherspark in exchange for his freedom.

entities.name: The Demon
entities.description: A skinless demon who tells Winter to bring the Aetherspark or belong to the House.

entities.name: Rashmi
entities.description: An inventor whose Planar Bridge revealed other worlds to Ishikari and who declined to recommend her.

entities.name: Gonti
entities.description: A Night Minister of the new Consulate whose name enrages Mohar.

entities.name: Madhu
entities.description: Sita's mother, whose father granted Mohar his Consulate position.

entities.name: Kolodin
entities.description: Chandra's mechanic whom she credits with honing their rides.

entities.name: Ghirapur
entities.description: The city on Kaladesh under attack by invaders, later host of the Grand Prix.

entities.name: Kaladesh
entities.description: The plane of aether-powered invention, renamed Avishkar after the revolution.

entities.name: The Consulate
entities.description: The former rulers of Kaladesh whose traditions Mohar defends.

entities.name: Aether Rangers
entities.description: Avishkar's hometown racing team, with a garage in a distant part of Ghirapur.

entities.name: Aetherspark
entities.description: A marvel of engineering found in Ishikari's lab after the invasion; the Grand Prix winner gets to claim it.

entities.name: Ishikari's Machine
entities.description: A net-like machine of hollowed scales meant to catch planar energy and use a natural mage's power.

entities.name: Ghirapur Grand Prix
entities.description: A race across planes whose winner claims the Aetherspark.

entities.name: Planar Bridge
entities.description: An invention that made it obvious other worlds exist.

entities.name: The Aether Revolt
entities.description: The uprising on Kaladesh that ended the Consulate's old rule.

entities.name: Blind Eternities
entities.description: The space between planes in which Ishikari's consciousness briefly merges.

events.summary: Ishikari faces the invasion of Ghirapur as warships are fired upon, resolved to make her death count.
events.quote: As the cannons of Ghirapur fire upon the toothy warships of the invaders

events.summary: Ishikari climbs her workshop tower, recalling how Rashmi's Planar Bridge revealed other worlds.
events.quote: Up the stairs she goes.

events.summary: Ishikari recalls her first dream of Ghirapur under attack and the hope she could carve from it.
events.quote: Shortly after that , Ishikari had the first dream.

events.summary: On the tower top, Ishikari sees planar windows tearing open in the sky.
events.quote: The yawning pits across the sky, the glimpses into worlds she could only imagine.

events.summary: Ishikari presents her improvised net machine, built in defiance of the Consulate.
events.quote: Crafted from whatever she could get her hands on in defiance of the Consulate and good sense alike

events.summary: Ishikari realizes the incomplete machine, which needs a mage's power, may kill her.
events.quote: to activate it may kill her

events.summary: Ishikari pulls the lever and her consciousness joins the Blind Eternities, attaining the unattainable.
events.quote: Ishikari pulls the lever—and in that moment, as her consciousness briefly becomes one with the Blind Eternities—she really does attain the unattainable.

events.summary: Sita, the underground racing queen Spitfire, struggles over the estate wall and sneaks home.
events.quote: Ghirapur's current queen of underground racing, the mysterious and tough and seemingly unbeatable Spitfire, is having some trouble climbing the wall

events.summary: Sita hides her racing suit and changes into the dress her father expects.
events.quote: She hides her racing suit in her nightstand and hurries to change into the dress he expects of her.

events.summary: Mohar, who has not shed his consul's trappings, doles out strict expectations to Sita.
events.quote: Mohar Varma, Sita's father, has not yet shed the stations and signifiers of his former office

events.summary: Sita corrects her father that the plane is now called Avishkar and argues about tradition.
events.quote: It's Avishkar now

events.summary: A radio report announces the Grand Prix winner will claim the Aetherspark.
events.quote: The winner of the Ghirapur Grand Prix gets to claim this once-in-a-lifetime chance at ultimate power and freedom.

events.summary: Mohar hurls the radio across the room at the mention of Gonti.
events.quote: The moment Gonti's name is announced on the radio, Mohar hurls it across the room.

events.summary: Mohar says Sita must be married advantageously, and then notices aether fumes on her.
events.quote: We must find you an advantageous marriage somewhere

events.summary: Sita puts on her Spitfire mask.
events.quote: Sita puts on the mask.

events.summary: Spitfire arrives at the Aether Rangers' garage where screens show Chandra Nalaar.
events.quote: Chandra Nalaar's face is smiling across all their screens.

events.summary: Pia Nalaar reveals she has upgraded Spitfire's racer with advanced aether systems.
events.quote: A ten-cylinder aether inverter system, two separate cyclonic mitigators

events.summary: Chandra is mobbed by reporters over tea and tries to joke with them.
events.quote: Chandra picks up her teacup in one hand and waves with the other.

events.summary: Chandra reveals that her only reason to race is to put a smile on Nissa's face.
events.quote: The only reason she's doing any of this is to put a smile on that face.

events.summary: Chandra says she wishes her mother the best as long as it is second place.
events.quote: I wish her all the best, as long as 'the best' is second place.

events.summary: Winter studies Chandra on a screen while ghouls work on his racer and a demon stares at him.
events.quote: He just needs to study her—her and all the other racers.

events.summary: A demon tells Winter to bring the Aetherspark or belong to the House.
events.quote: Bring us the Aetherspark, and you're free. Fail, and you belong to the House.

relations.note: Chandra wants to win the Aetherspark for Nissa.
relations.quote: How much it would mean to see Nissa's eyes light up the way they used to.
Her machine, her child, her legacy to the world.

relations.note: Must fetch the Aetherspark or belong to the House.
relations.quote: Fail, and you belong to the House.
